name: Tocumen International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longer, 03R/21L, is 3,050 m x 45 m concrete; 03L/21R is 2,682 m x 45 m asphalt

hours.v: ATS, fuel and handling H24; airport administration Mon-Fri 1300-2130 UTC (08:00-16:30 local)

noise.v: no overflight of the city below 5,000 ft until crossing the coast (24 h, turboprops and jets); from 0100 to 1100 UTC (20:00-06:00 local) no overflight of the city at any altitude
noise.quote: En horario desde las 0100UTC hasta las 1100UTC, no se permitirá el sobrevuelo sobre la ciudad (a cualquier altitud).

handling.v: stands on the general aviation apron are assigned by the airport management centre
handling.quote: Los puestos de estacionamientos en la Plataforma de Aviación General serán asignados por el Centro de Gestión Aeroportuaria

notes: Read: Panama AIP AD 2.1-MPTO, AAC Panama (aeronautica.gob.pa), pages AMDT AIRAC 8 of 31 OCT 24 with later pages to AMDT 02 and 04; and AIP AMDT 02-26 (effective 30 JUN 2026), which for MPTO only removes an obstacle and reissues chart/obstacle pages (no change to hours, runways or local rules seen; the AMDT text was not read past the first 100,000 characters). The noise wording is Spanish; English is a translation. Only the first half of AD 2.1-MPTO was read in detail. No curfew, slot or PPR rule seen in the part read. Self-powered pushback is prohibited. IATA code not stated.
